name: How long does a typical window installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window installation project varies depending on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the installation. For a standard home, most installations can be completed within one to three days. Larger projects or those requiring significant structural adjustments may take longer. We work efficiently to minimize disruption to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical window installation for a home usually takes between one to three days, depending on project scope.
